questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 'it is generally __________ that'는 가주어 it을 쓴 수동태 구문이므로 acknowledge를 과거분사 acknowledged로 바꾼다.
det.analysis: it is generally __________ (acknowledge) that ... → 「it is + 과거분사 + that절」 수동태 → acknowledge를 acknowledged로
det.tip: it is generally acknowledged that ~ = ~라고 일반적으로 인정된다 (수동)

questions.passage: With the rise of the networked communications environment and the continuing progress of scientific advances, knowledge has become an increasingly key factor in fostering innovation, growth and health care technology and in sustaining cultural creativity. In addition, the ability of people to acquire, access and control knowledge is strictly related to questions pertaining to the ownership of knowledge. At present, intellectual property rules are the principal tool for controlling the creation, diffusion and use of knowledge and related goods and services. In order to have a market in knowledge, intellectual property protection is considered __________ for creators of knowledge securing and maintaining exclusive access rights to knowledge-based products. For example, in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry, where development of new products requires substantial investments with long incubation periods, it is generally acknowledged that companies need exclusive right in order to recover research and development costs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 지식 시장을 위해 지식재산권 보호는 창작자가 독점적 접근 권리를 확보하는 '근본적인 도구(a fundamental instrument)'로 여겨진다는 맥락이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① a fundamental instrument — 근본적인 도구 ←정답 (창작자에게 필수적 수단)
❌ ② a minor obstacle — 사소한 장애물 (문맥 반대)
❌ ③ a temporary measure — 일시적 조치 (근본적이라는 맥락과 반대)
❌ ④ an optional feature — 선택적 기능 (필수적이라는 맥락과 반대)
det.tip: is considered a fundamental instrument = 근본적인 도구로 여겨진다

questions.passage: With the rise of the networked communications environment and the continuing progress of scientific advances, knowledge has become an increasingly key factor in fostering innovation, growth and health care technology and in sustaining cultural creativity. In addition, the ability of people to acquire, access and control knowledge is strictly related to questions pertaining to the ownership of knowledge. At present, intellectual property rules are the principal tool for controlling the creation, diffusion and use of knowledge and related goods and services. In order to have a market in knowledge, intellectual property protection is considered a fundamental instrument for creators of knowledge securing and maintaining exclusive access rights to knowledge-based products. For example, in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry, where development of new products requires substantial investments with long incubation periods, it is generally acknowledged that companies need exclusive right in order to __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 신제품 개발에 상당한 투자와 오랜 잠복기가 필요하므로, 기업은 '연구 개발비를 회수하기(recover research and development costs)' 위해 독점권이 필요하다는 맥락이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① expand into entirely new markets — 완전히 새로운 시장으로 확장 (본문에 없는 내용)
❌ ② hide their latest inventions forever — 최신 발명을 영원히 숨김 (본문 논지와 무관)
❌ ③ avoid all future legal disputes — 모든 법적 분쟁을 피함 (본문에 없는 내용)
✅ ④ recover research and development costs — 연구 개발비를 회수함 ←정답
det.tip: need exclusive right in order to recover research and development costs = 개발비 회수를 위해 독점권이 필요
